easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
